findings.headline: Variable sidebar test uses invalid editor commands

The app also normalizes variable names through `toSnakeCase` in `assets/js/aui/shared/jotted/VariablePopover.tsx:252-263`, so assertions for `VarOne` and `VarTwo` are stale against implemented behavior. Because `assets/js/views/docs/create/VariableDetails.tsx:102-109` renders the sidebar only when variables exist, the run never reached the feature under test.
findings.whatHappened: The run created a blank agreement and clicked into the editor, but it typed literal key tokens like `{enter}` into the document instead of creating variables. It never reached the Details sidebar or exercised the VarOne/VarTwo navigation assertions. `prior_runs` shows this test has never passed or even run before.
